proposed_question.text: For eaves over required windows under PD 1096 Rule VII Section 704.1(c), what minimum distance from side and rear property lines is stated?

rationale.correct: Section 704.1(c) states that eaves over required windows shall not be less than 750 mm from the side and rear property lines.

distractors.A: 300 mm is not the Section 704.1(c) value for eaves over required windows.
distractors.B: 500 mm is not the cited value.
distractors.D: 1200 mm is not the Section 704.1(c) eaves-over-required-windows distance.

rationale.takeaway: Attach 750 mm to the exact Section 704.1(c) condition: eaves over required windows, measured from side and rear property lines.
